newsitem.title: CHINA: China eases quarantine checks with Hong Kong.
newsitem.headline: China eases quarantine checks with Hong Kong.

text.p: China simplified border formalities between its Shenzhen Special Economic Zone and Hong Kong on Thursday by withdrawing some animal and plant quarantine controls, the Xinhua news agency said.

Drivers passing through Shenzhen would no longer have to stop for the four checks that were previously in force, it said. They would only have to fill in declaration forms for their vehicles and goods before exit and entry.
Cargoes of plants and vegetables will be checked before reaching the border, while animal quarantine officials will step up checks at port of entry areas and cargo destinations.
Shenzhen has three land ports of entry, handling more than eight million vehicles a year and accounting for 70 percent of China's total land trade.
Most of Hong Kong's vegetables are brought across the border from China.
